description: Automated test script for verifying cellular manager parameters when status is CONNECTED, using TDK libraries and specific parameter checks.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Wrapper class for TDK test scripting functionalities.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test actions.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test case with expected result validation.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result status of the executed test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output of the test step.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the module load operation.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified module after test completion.
